name: reviewer-v1.2
description: Split manifest for Reviewer-LoRA v1.2 training. Extends v1.1 with 6 source-backport-specific negatives and procps as a hard prefetch-failure-distractor positive.

sqlite.reason: sqlite (CVE-2022-46908) was in dev under hash-based assignment (bucket=72). LoRA v1.0 false-rejected this example, hallucinating a wrong UNUSED_PARAMETER direction. Moving to train so the model sees the correct positive during training. Carried forward from v1.1.

note: v1.2 adds 6 source-backport-specific negatives: 2x reversed-hunk (sqlite, procps), 2x missing-hunk (sqlite, zbar), 2x partial-hunk (procps, zbar). All hash to train. Procps positive (correct patch + prefetch_failures[required_for_patch=false]) is a hard positive case. reviewer.v4.md is the system prompt for v1.2 training.
